def calculate_player_consistency(df):
    stats = df.groupby('player').agg({'points': ['mean', 'std']})
    stats.columns = ['avg_pts', 'std_pts']
    grouped_pts = df.groupby('player')['points']
    consistency = grouped_pts.transform(lambda x: (x - x.mean()).abs().mean())
    stats['consistency_err'] = df.assign(ce=consistency).groupby('player')['ce'].first()
    return stats.sort_values('consistency_err')

def extract_visit_markers(df, patient_ids, marker_cols):
    row_indices = df.index[df['patient_id'].isin(patient_ids)]
    selected_markers = []
    for (i, row_idx) in enumerate(row_indices):
        col = marker_cols[i % len(marker_cols)]
        selected_markers.append((row_idx, col))
    (rows, cols) = zip(*selected_markers)
    row_pos = df.index.get_indexer(rows)
    col_pos = df.columns.get_indexer(cols)
    values = df.to_numpy()[row_pos, col_pos]
    return pd.Series(values, index=rows, name='marker_value')
